title: CENSUS.json — the complete identity inventory (stage 1)
description: One row per parcel. NO PAID CALL MAY FIRE while any REQ field is 'missing' (as distinct from 'explicitly-unavailable'). The Source column of references/data_census.md is a per-county field map, not a global schema — literal field names live in config/counties/*.json. Recorded for audit ONLY. A vendor's matchConfidence, matched:true, or a field literally named property_owner:true is NEVER an input to any predicate or gate (doctrines 2 and 4).
